plan.notes: Source: Palomar College Program Pathways Mapper (official), American Indian Studies Certificate of Achievement Program pathway map, https://programmap.palomar.edu/pathway/american-indian-studies-to-career/?pt=map&year=2026, retrieved 2026-10-06. Palomar publishes the program total as a range (18 units); total_credits (18) is the exact sum of the minimum-unit pathway. All AA/AS/AA-T/AS-T degrees require 60 units per Palomar; maps represent one possible pathway — see a counselor for a personalized plan.

courses.title: Choose one: AIS 101 or 102
courses.choice_note: Palomar mapper choice group (3-3 units; transcribed at minimum 3). Options: AIS 101 — History of American Indian Nations from Creation through the Present; AIS 102 — The American Indian and the U.S. Political System

courses.title: Choose one: Major ELECTIVES
courses.choice_note: Palomar mapper choice group (3-3 units; transcribed at minimum 3). Options: AIS 115 — A History of Southwest Indians; AIS 145 — American Indian Literature; AIS 150 — American Indian Philosophy and Religion; AIS 135 — California Indian Arts; AIS 166A — Elementary Cahuilla IA; AIS 107A — Elementary Luiseno IA; AIS 110 — History of the Plains Indian; AIS 130 — Prehistoric Cultures of North America; ANTH 130 — Prehistoric Cultures of North America; AIS 104 — The Music of Native America; ANTH 140 — The Original Californians; AIS 140 — The Original Californians; +1 more
